title: Marketplace listing: launch cue-cards + gated preflight
body:
Purpose:
This is a working cue-card + gated preflight for cloud marketplace listings and ISV partner launches. Goal is to create a compact, actionable checklist and short-copy variants that sales/partner ops can use when coordinating publisher/marketplace publication. Treat as a living doc — expect iterative changes during vendor reviews and legal gating.

Audience:
- Partner onboarding squad (partner-ops)
- GTM launch wrangler and content writer
- Marketplace publishers (AWS/Azure/GCP vendor teams)
- Solutions engineers / integration owners

Objectives (what success looks like):
1) Marketplace listing goes live in targeted region within SLA window (T+14 days after asset submission).
2) Listing copy validated by partner and legal; no security blockers in preflight.
3) All gated technical checks (billing SKU, network, SSO) have owners and sign-offs.
4) Partner enablement kit shipped w/ 1-pager, demo script, and sample API keys for validation.

Quick cue-cards (microcopy variants for UI fields)
- Tagline (16–40 chars):
  * "High-performance LLM inference, optimized for production"
  * "Predictable, cost-efficient LLM inference for apps"
- Short description (90–140 chars):
  * "Redwood Inference runs open and fine-tuned models reliably across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments — low-latency APIs and enterprise controls."
  * "Ship LLM features with production SLAs: streaming responses, cost controls, and private deployments for regulated workloads."
- Full listing blurb (200–300 chars):
  * "Redwood Inference provides a unified runtime for cost-efficient, reliable LLM inference. Choose hosted API for fastest time-to-value, reserved Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput, or Private deployment for VPC/on-prem control. Includes observability, rollout tooling, and model optimization recommendations."
- Key bullets (for feature list):
  * "Hosted API: REST + SDK, streaming, function/tool calling"
  * "Dedicated: reserved GPU pools, autoscaling, SLAs"
  * "Private: VPC or on-prem with KMS and audit logs"
  * "Optimize: batching, caching, quantization guidance to cut per-token cost"

Suggested marketing benefits (short list for landing card):
- "Reduce token cost by up to 3x with caching + batching"
- "99.9% SLA for Dedicated customers"
- "Same API across hosted, dedicated, private — minimize rework"

Sample buyer Q&A (for marketplace FAQ):
Q: Can I run private models in a VPC?
A: Yes — Redwood Private supports customer-managed VPCs and on-prem packaging for air-gapped environments.
Q: How are billing and quotas handled?
A: Marketplace billing maps to Redwood SKUs; Dedicated customers get reserved capacity invoices for monthly commits.
Q: What security certifications are available?
A: We publish SOC2 Type II scope and have enterprise integrations for KMS and audit logging (see security add-on).

Gated preflight checklist (must be green before submission)
- Commercial / Legal:
  [ ] Marketplace MSA reviewed (owner: partner-ops)
  [ ] Data processing addendum present (owner: legal)
  [ ] Pricing SKU mapping doc uploaded (owner: finance)
- Technical / Integration:
  [ ] Public API endpoints reachable from marketplace publisher sandbox (owner: infra-eng)
  [ ] Test invoice and metering payload validated (owner: billing-eng)
  [ ] CORS / redirect URIs verified for publisher console (owner: dx-engineering)
  [ ] Example deployment template (ARM/CloudFormation/GCP) included (owner: solutions-eng)
- Security / Compliance:
  [ ] Encryption-at-rest validated and KMS flow documented (owner: security)
  [ ] Audit log retention and export path documented for marketplace auditors (owner: platform-ops)
  [ ] Least-privilege service account documented for publisher integration (owner: infra-eng)
- Content / UX:
  [ ] Short description + tagline approved by partner marketing (owner: partner-marketing)
  [ ] Demo script + video (30–60s) uploaded to artifact bucket (owner: enablement)
notes:
Preflight notes and open questions:
- Pricing: confirm whether marketplace will require net-new SKU or mapping to existing (JIRA-3721).
- Trials: partner teams often prefer time-limited free trials — need to map to trial entitlement in Redwood billing.
- Localization: decide english-only first pass; if we localize, headline/benefits need region-specific copy and legal review.

Operational timeline (recommended cadence):
- Day 0: Kickoff + MSA check
- Day 1–3: Technical smoke tests in publisher sandbox
- Day 4–7: Content freeze and legal review
- Day 8–12: Final integration tests and billing validation
- Day 13–14: Submit assets to publisher for publish window

Publisher acceptance steps (who does what):
- Partner-ops: orchestrate cross-functional sign-offs, upload assets
- Solutions-eng: ship templates, demo keys, run smoke tests
- Security: provide audit log proof and KMS workflow
- Finance: SKU pricing confirmation and invoice mapping

Integration QA matrix (minimal testcases):
- Authentication: SSO and API key flow
- Latency: 95th percentile under 200ms for sample payloads (or documented expected profile)
- Metering: marketplace usage events map to Redwood meter with no drop > 0.5% of events
- Error handling: fallback model variant returns with 503->200 fallback within 3s

Open todos (to resolve before final):
- [ ] Confirm publisher sandbox window length with AWS/partner rep (owner: Samir)
- [ ] Finalize 2 pricing SKU variants (basic + enterprise) and example invoice (owner: finance)
- [ ] Record 30s demo clip showing Dedicated failover behavior (owner: solutions-eng)

Notes-to-self (informal):
- Keep the marketplace page concise; long lists of features get truncated by vendor UI. Use 3 bullets max on the hero and push details into a linked docs page.
- When in doubt, default to the "single-sentence benefit + 3 bullets" pattern used by major publishers.

Version history (trace):
- 2026-02-28: Initial draft (Samir)
- 2026-03-03: Content tweaks from Evelyn (copy edits)
- 2026-03-08: Security gating checklist added by Maya

End of doc.
